Rig dump taken from Studio, from Workspace.Pistol_VM.
Geometry is the free Glock mesh set the project owner supplied; markers and joints were
assembled by script. Positions are relative to Main, which is the model's PrimaryPart.

2026-09-28: every size and position scaled by 0.55 so the Glock matches the arms and the
M4A1 (0.041 studs per cm; the slide was 1.41 studs, about twice a real 18.6 cm Glock
once MeshTemplates drew the meshes at their true size). HandRMount sits on the grip axis
and HandLMount just left of it, for the support hand wrapped round the shooting hand.

Regenerate assets/viewmodels/pistol.model.json from this with:
    python3 scripts/build_viewmodel.py pistol
